intro.html: Wrap Around Extensions That Make Your Home Work Better
Need more room without moving home? Fortunately, our wrap around extensions can transform the way you use your property.

Here at Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we design and build wrap around extensions around your home, lifestyle, and priorities. Delivering practical spaces that feel like they always belonged. By extending across the side and rear, you can create valuable extra space while improving your home’s layout. You can open up cramped rooms, connect indoor areas, and bring more natural light into everyday spaces.
Ready to make better use of your home’s space? Get in touch with Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction for wrap around extensions in Ely, Bury St Edmunds, Newmarket, and Cambridge.

blocks.html: What if you could gain significantly more usable space without sacrificing the character of your existing home? Well, our wrap around extensions give you greater flexibility than a straightforward rear or side extension. Combining both areas. Creating a larger footprint and more opportunities for a thoughtful layout. So you could create a spacious kitchen, add a dining area, introduce a utility room, or build a more sociable family space. Better still, you can design each area around how you actually live.
Combining Side And Rear Space

Why choose between extending sideways or extending backwards when you can combine both? Our wrap around extensions join your side and rear spaces into one cohesive addition. This can unlock areas that currently feel disconnected, narrow, or difficult to use.

Creating A More Open, Connected Home

Does your current layout make everyday life feel more complicated than it should? Luckily, our wrap around extensions can help you remove barriers between key living areas. So you can connect your kitchen, dining space and garden while keeping each area purposeful. Creating a stronger connection throughout your home.

chapters.heading: Wrap Around Extensions For Better Layouts

blocks.html: Extra square footage only helps when you can use it properly. Which is why we focus on the layout as much as the construction itself. Looking at how you move through your home, where you need storage, and how you use your living spaces. Ensuring the result feels like a completely different home, without the upheaval of moving elsewhere.
Open-Plan Kitchens And Entertaining Areas

Want a kitchen that becomes the heart of your home? Thankfully, our wrap around extensions can give you the space to create a generous kitchen and dining area. So you could add an island, introduce a larger dining table, or create a relaxed seating zone. Creating room for everyday family life while making your home feel brighter and more spacious.
Making Awkward Spaces Work Harder

Side spaces often sit underused because they feel too narrow or awkward. However, our wrap around extensions can turn that overlooked space into something genuinely useful. Incorporate it into your wider layout rather than treating it as a separate addition.

chapters.heading: How Much Space Can You Gain?

blocks.html: Wondering how much additional space a wrap around extension could give you? The answer depends on your property, boundaries, existing layout, planning requirements, and the design you choose. And every home presents different opportunities. But we can help you explore those opportunities and develop a solution that makes sensible use of your available footprint.
Making The Most Of Your Property’s Footprint

You don’t always need a huge extension to make a noticeable difference. Instead, the right design can use previously wasted areas while improving the relationship between existing and new rooms. And combining side and rear space often creates more flexibility than extending in one direction alone. This means you can prioritise the rooms and features that matter most to you.
Designing Around Light, Access And Flow

More space should never mean less comfort. So we consider natural light, movement, access and sightlines when developing your extension. This helps your new space feel bright, practical and connected to the rest of your home.
Good design can help you:

items: Bring more daylight into your home.
Connect old and new spaces naturally.

blocks.html: So in the end, you get more than additional floor area. But you also get a home that works better from room to room.

chapters.heading: A Wrap Around Extension Built Around You

blocks.html: Your home isn’t a standard template. So your extension shouldn’t be either. And here at Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we take a bespoke approach to every project. Building around your property and your priorities. Creating a result that supports the way you want to live.
Bespoke Solutions For Your Home’s Layout

What would you change about your home if you had the space? Perhaps you want a larger kitchen. Maybe you need better garden access or somewhere for the whole family to relax. Or you might simply want your existing rooms to connect more naturally. Whatever you have in mind, we can help turn those ideas into a practical extension. Helping your new space complement what you already have.
Careful Construction From Foundations To Finishes

A great extension needs more than a good idea. But it also needs careful construction at every stage. Which is why we manage the build with attention to detail. From the foundations through to the final finishes. Focusing on creating a solid, practical addition that integrates with your existing property.
You can expect a construction approach focused on:

items: A considered connection between old and new.
